en.title: The Lost and Found Shelf at Kotokoto Secondhand Bookstore
en.premise: At the secondhand bookstore I run, there is a special shelf dedicated to sorting out the 'little memories' left behind by owners—like bookmarks tucked between pages or handwritten notes. One day, an old diary detailing a 'vanished village' that should no longer exist on any map arrives at the shop, setting off a series of mysterious connections. This is a story about slowly unraveling, over a cup of tea, the true nature of goodwill left behind by someone thinking of another, yet never quite reaching them.

zh.title: 旧书店“琴琴”的遗物整理架
zh.premise: 在我经营的旧书店里，有一个专门整理书签、随笔等前主人遗留下的“微小记忆”的架子。有一天，店里收到了一本记录着本该从地图上消失的“消失村落”的旧日记，以此为契机，一段不可思议的缘分就此展开。这是一个伴随着茶香，缓缓解开那些某人思念着他人、却未能传达的善意真相的故事。
